manual_notes: Proteasome inhibitor MG132 blocked FOXP3 downregulation.
Tenidap inhibited IL6 synthesis.
APP induced thymine dimerization and APP is not PARP2.
Epicatechin extract inhibited Plasmodium Hsp70 but not HSPA9.
High glucose downregulated the MCM7 host promoter.
Ruxolitinib was tested as a STAT6 pathway inhibitor.
Vanadium induced MIP2 mRNA expression.
Haloperidol increased FGF2 expression.
Progesterone increased CacyBP expression.
Palmitate activated p38 but the normalized object is GRAP2.
Isoniazid increased Atg3 expression.
Doxycycline induced shRNA directed against Tom40.
Cip1 is a tomato protease and not SLC12A9.
FSH condition involved ALP but the normalized object is ASRGL1.
Iron induced Hrg1 mRNA.
Urea was a denaturation reagent and MSP1 is not SP1.
Ten is ordinary fold-change text rather than pentaerythritol tetranitrate.
Brigatinib inhibited cells expressing CD74 ROS1 fusion.
MPP is not fenthion in this omega 3 treatment context.
FGF7 response repressed Snail and Snail is not a chemical subject.
Linoleic acid induced GRP94 expression.
A sterol inhibitor bound CYP51 but soy sterol specificity is not shown.
Trx inhibited UV effects on collagen expression.
Bmp7 regulated Shh expression by location.
tBHQ reduced CD25 expressing NK cells.
Ser labels phosphorylation sites rather than SIGLEC1.
Cisplatin increased OAT4 but the normalized object is SLC22A9.
ddC increased phospho Erk1 or Erk2.
Entinostat downregulated N cadherin.
Ketamine decreased synaptotagmin I.
Cisplatin reduced RPA2 phosphorylation but the normalized object is RPLP1.
DLC1 inhibited phosphorylation at a threonine residue.
Iloprost weakly inhibited CES1.
Sildenafil stimulation increased phosphorylated AGO2.
Ribavirin resistance correlated with sonic hedgehog pathway marker GLI1 not DHH.
CDNF reduced amphetamine induced behavior.
Bromocriptine increased estrogen receptor levels.
DDP4i is a DPP4 inhibitor context and not Mitometh.
cAMP caused phosphorylation and activation of PDE4D variants.
TSA induced Gadd45 alpha and beta.
Oleic acid increased EphB2 expression.
Nicotine inhibited Col1A1 induction.
SNAP is nitric oxide donor and restored sildenafil response.
Menadione inhibited IGF1 stimulated Akt signaling rather than IGF1 itself.
beta Sitosterol reduced MIP1alpha but the normalized object is ZW10.
EPA increased Tmem26 expression.
Pamidronate upregulated FAS mediated apoptosis proteins.
Osimertinib downregulated E2F1.
ER DP plus aspirin reduced PECAM1 expression.
High sodium chloride diet elevated NHA2 transcripts and protein.
